name: Embed
description: A map or another external page embedded in the site: optional title, a picture shown before loading, the live embed after the visitor allows it, optional caption. Nothing loads from the provider before that click.
when_to_use: Show where the business is (a map) or embed another site's page (a booking widget, a form hosted elsewhere). Not for videos: YouTube and Vimeo go in the Video element. Not for images: use the Image Slider or a section's media.
capabilities: two-click consent: picture + provider notice + 'Inhalt laden' + 'always load {provider}' (remembered in the browser)
kind: map or iframe; the provider is named from the address (Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, Apple Maps, else the host) unless set
https addresses only; YouTube/Vimeo are refused (Video element)

variants.description: Title, the embed box at content width, caption. The only variant upstream (pos268).

breakpoints.mobile: Full width; while the consent panel shows, the box grows to fit it (min 260px), the loaded embed keeps its ratio.
breakpoints.desktop: Content width; consent panel centred over the picture.

ai.prompt_summary: Embed: a map or external page behind a consent panel. Settings: variant (contained), kind (map|iframe), title, caption, src (https embed address, e.g. the src of Google Maps' 'Karte einbetten' iframe or an OpenStreetMap export/embed.html URL), provider (optional display name), image (picture shown before loading), aspect_ratio ('16/9'|'4/3'|'3/2'|'1/1'|'21/9'), heading_level, show_title, show_caption.
ai.content_guidelines: Always set src to the provider's EMBED address, not the page address (Google Maps: maps/embed?pb=…; OpenStreetMap: export/embed.html?bbox=…). A caption naming the provider ('Karte: OpenStreetMap') is good practice. Never put a YouTube/Vimeo link here.

field_hints.src: https only. The embed address, loaded after consent.
field_hints.image: Optional: a screenshot of the map; otherwise a neutral box behind the consent panel.
field_hints.provider: Leave empty unless the derived name is wrong.
